scope: 教员 v1.1 访客、积分计费与防滥用实现
implemented: 访客内容/钱包/试用资格分离与一次试用
北京时间每日赠送、到期优先消费、冻结与实际用量结算
四类token用量归一化及版本价格；平台现金预算与搜索承诺
注册登录强人机验证、公网管理员TOTP与近期验证
报价确认、重放及并发保护、断线恢复、停止结算与未知用量期限
账户归入任务与冲突映射；临时对话与退出隔离
后台人工验证配置、价格草稿、双人调账、退款与费用对账
风险事件、人工申诉、账户解除审计、受限账本投影重建
原子会话保存、精确身份数据库恢复、打包隐私过滤

public_checkout.source: git index in an isolated directory; no local secrets or runtime copied
public_checkout.bootstrap: 37 evidence cards / 25 quotes / 10 events / 13 methodology rules
public_checkout.skip_reason: 8 optional full PDF/OCR integration cases; public curated-data tests run

configuration: Turnstile keys/domain, model CNY rates, platform daily budget and search cost bound are entered manually by an administrator; missing configuration fails closed.

release_inventory.scope: staged Git contents including DOCX XML; credentials, private state, paths and size checks

limits: Actual-domain Turnstile and public HTTPS deployment were not exercised.
A small real gateway response validates that sample usage shape; account-specific prices and all supplier behavior remain operator checks.
Browser regression uses isolated databases and fake external providers; it does not prove long-term advice quality or production load capacity.
Clearing every credential or changing devices cannot uniquely identify a person; platform cash limits bound subsidy exposure.
